text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While eagerly awaiting her showdown with Eishin Flash in the Arima Kinen, Gold Ship suddenly—like, alarmingly suddenly―discovers the power of beauty!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship plans to take over the world with her beauty, but when the avatar of beauty T.M. Opera O overhears this, she simply cannot let it slide!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Two elegant auras clash with enough intensity to make anyone nauseous, in a battle through which beauty standards may not survive. Neither side yields…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, they acknowledge each other as worthy foes. The beauty of Gold Ship and T.M. Opera O's friendship is beyond words… Their battle ends in a draw!
